summary: Add three Descartes extreme mutation types and a --descartes selection flag (ADR 0012). EXTREME_VOID, EXTREME_ZERO, and EXTREME_CONSTANT are normal public mutation types, disabled by default. Each one is a registered function-level spec in internal/engine. The spec adds one return statement before the original statements of a function declaration body and restores the original statement list before Apply returns. EXTREME_VOID applies to a function without results. EXTREME_ZERO returns nil, false, 0, or an empty string for each result. EXTREME_CONSTANT returns true, 1, or "A" for each basic result and nil for each nilable result. Result kinds come from the syntax of the result types. A predeclared identifier counts only when no declaration of the package, and no type parameter, receiver, parameter, or result of the function, declares that name. A function candidate has the func keyword as its anchor, the first body statement as its coverage position, and the declaration lines as its diff range. internal/diff gets one range check. internal/mutator owns Descartes group membership. internal/configuration adds the boolean key unleash.descartes and one helper that gives the effective enablement of a type. internal/report adds three omitempty statistics fields. cmd adds the --descartes flag; the per-type flags come from mutator.Types. No new package, dependency, process, environment value, output destination, status, or exit code.
trust_boundaries: The operator still selects local Go code and runs its tests with the caller's permissions. The new specs edit only the shared in-memory AST under the existing parsed-file lock, and the existing mutant writes the printed bytes only to the physical file in the worker copy through os.Root. The engine reads the other Go files of a package directory through the existing module fs.FS to find package-level names; it parses them and executes nothing. The added return statement keeps every original statement, so imports and variables stay used; no import, source text, or test file is removed or rewritten. The new boolean key and its GREMLINS_UNLEASH_DESCARTES environment form carry no secret. No process argument, environment value, network destination, credential, persistent store, or workflow changes.
